courses.name: Aurelia Fundamentals
curriculum: Business-computer capabilities and appropriate configuration selection
Hands-on common editing, Business Tools and introductory Abacus

fundamentals_purchase_credit.dealer_reimbursement: Logix reimburses participating dealers; do not deduct the credit from their agreed margin.
fundamentals_purchase_credit.scope: Standalone two-day Fundamentals. Existing $150 vouchers for the other before-you-buy courses remain unchanged; no stacking or extension to other courses is implied.
fundamentals_purchase_credit.accounting: Reserve the redeemed credit once as promotional expense across the course and computer sale, outside recurring manufacturing costs.

launch_program.tuition_positioning: A modest fraction of an Aurelia package price; publish exact tuition and a named package comparison when commercial prices are selected. Generated pricing proposals are not approved tuition.
launch_program.teaching: Small classes, substantial hands-on time, ideally one machine per participant or pair; business tools, introductory Abacus and advice on appropriate configurations and unnecessary purchases.
